ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: The figure is an isoline distribution map of the annual average number of rainstorm days in Sichuan Province from 1961 to 2008, with Chengdu and latitude and longitude lines marked. The isolines of rainstorm days are distributed in belts around the margin of the Sichuan Basin, and the isolines with higher values are concentrated at the basin edge, close to the surrounding mountains. Then reason: The question asks what type of zone in Sichuan is more likely to form rainstorms. In the figure, the high-value areas of rainstorm days correspond to the edge of the Sichuan Basin and the mountain front. This type of location belongs to a piedmont zone. Therefore, in Sichuan, the type of zone that is often more likely to form rainstorms is a piedmont zone.
